data.Name: Drogon DG0 – Prospect Risk (Trap & Seal)
data.Description: Risk that the Valysar prospect does not contain a viable hydrocarbon accumulation. Key elements: 4-way dip closure on Top Brent may be breached by sub-seismic faults; seal effectiveness of Upper Volantis shales uncertain at burial depth >3500 m; hydrocarbon charge timing relative to trap formation. Pre-drill Pg estimate ~0.65 based on regional analogues.
data.MitigationPlan: Seismic reprocessing for fault detection; AVO analysis for fluid discrimination; regional seal study from offset wells.

data.Name: Drogon DG0 – Data Maturity & Analogue Dependency
data.Description: Risk that pre-drill subsurface understanding is insufficient for reliable volumetric and concept screening. No well penetration in Valysar at DG0; reservoir properties (porosity, NTG, Sw) based on Snorre/Statfjord analogues. Seismic depth conversion uncertainty ±50 m at reservoir level. OWC position inferred from regional pressure gradients only.
data.MitigationPlan: Plan exploration/appraisal well with core + MDT program; acquire velocity survey for depth calibration; commission analogue study from Snorre Brent reservoir.

data.Name: Drogon DG0 – Commercial Viability
data.Description: Risk that the Drogon development is not commercially viable under realistic oil price and cost scenarios. Analogue-based STOIIP range 25–45 MSm³ with recovery factor 20–35% yields EUR 5–16 MSm³. Breakeven oil price estimated 45–65 USD/bbl depending on concept. CAPEX uncertainty ±40% at screening stage. Sensitive to host platform tariff and production start date.
data.MitigationPlan: Run economic screening with P10/P50/P90 volumes × 3 oil price scenarios; benchmark CAPEX against recent subsea tie-backs in Tampen area; confirm host platform capacity and availability.

data.Name: Drogon DG0 – Infrastructure Access & Tie-back
data.Description: Risk that suitable host infrastructure is unavailable or uneconomic for a Drogon tie-back. Nearest candidates: Njord A (semi-sub, 15 km), Draugen (concrete, 25 km). Host platform processing capacity, remaining field life, and flow assurance (hydrates, wax, corrosion in long subsea flowlines) all uncertain at DG0. Pipeline routing across seabed terrain may add cost.
data.MitigationPlan: Host platform capacity study; flow assurance screening (wax appearance, hydrate curve); pipeline routing desktop study; engage host platform operator for capacity reservation.
